Rules: usql is READ-ONLY and for LOCAL files only (e.g. SQLite/agent-history.db): SELECT / FTS MATCH only. For any database server (postgres, mssql) or credentials, tell the orchestrator to use sub-expert-db.

CliTools.Name: exiftool
CliTools.UseCase: Read metadata of images and documents. Example: `exiftool file.jpg`.

CliTools.Name: markitdown
CliTools.UseCase: Convert pdf, docx, html, xlsx, images to Markdown to read them. Example: `markitdown <file>`.

CliTools.Name: pandoc
CliTools.UseCase: Convert documents between formats. Example: `pandoc in.docx -t gfm`.

CliTools.Name: usql
CliTools.UseCase: Universal SQL CLI. Example: `usql "sqlite:///C:/data/app.db" -c "\dt"`. Output: `-J` JSON, `-C` CSV, `-t` rows only.

CliTools.Name: ilspycmd
CliTools.UseCase: Decompile .NET assemblies. Example: `ilspycmd -p assembly.dll`, `ilspycmd -t Namespace.Type assembly.dll`.
